_meta.description: Named phylogenetic clades used by MetaAves. Clades are not forced into Linnaean rank fields.

sources.name: Jarvis et al. 2014
sources.note: Genome-scale avian phylogeny supporting major clades including Telluraves, Afroaves and Australaves.

_meta.uncertaintyPolicy: Only relationships with useful broad support are encoded in the backbone. Contested deep Neoaves relationships remain explicitly unresolved rather than presented as certain.

clade:Palaeognathae.name: Palaeognathae
clade:Palaeognathae.description: Living birds traditionally comprising ratites and tinamous.

clade:Galloanserae.name: Galloanserae
clade:Galloanserae.description: Major clade containing Anseriformes and Galliformes.

clade:Neoaves.name: Neoaves
clade:Neoaves.description: Large clade containing most living bird species.

clade:Telluraves.name: Telluraves
clade:Telluraves.description: Core landbird clade containing Afroaves and Australaves.

clade:Afroaves.name: Afroaves
clade:Afroaves.description: A major Telluraves lineage including groups such as Accipitriformes, Strigiformes, Coliiformes and several cavity-nesting bird lineages. Deep relationships within Afroaves remain an active phylogenetic research topic.

clade:Australaves.name: Australaves
clade:Australaves.description: A major Telluraves lineage containing Cariamiformes, Falconiformes, Psittaciformes and Passeriformes.

clade:Aequornithes.name: Aequornithes
clade:Aequornithes.note: Included as a named Neoaves clade, but its exact placement relative to other major Neoaves lineages is not hard-coded here.

clade:Mirandornithes.name: Mirandornithes
clade:Mirandornithes.note: Flamingos and grebes; placement among major Neoaves lineages is kept separate from the simplified backbone.

clade:Columbimorphae.name: Columbimorphae
clade:Columbimorphae.note: Named clade associated with Columbiformes, Pterocliformes and Mesitornithiformes in major phylogenomic treatments.

clade:Otidimorphae.name: Otidimorphae
clade:Otidimorphae.note: Named clade containing Cuculiformes, Musophagiformes and Otidiformes in major phylogenomic treatments.

clade:Strisores.name: Strisores
clade:Strisores.note: Named clade containing hummingbirds, swifts and several nocturnal bird lineages.

clade:Eurypygimorphae.name: Eurypygimorphae
clade:Eurypygimorphae.description: Named Neoaves clade containing tropicbirds (Phaethontiformes) and sunbitterns/kagu (Eurypygiformes) in phylogenomic classifications.
